bibl.title: Curses in Acts: Hearing the Apostles' Words of Judgment Alongside "Magical" Spell Texts.
bibl.seg: Benedict H.M. Kent, Curses in Acts: Hearing the Apostles' Words of Judgment Alongside "Magical" Spell Texts.
Journal for the Study of the New Testament 39 (2017) pp. 412-440.
bibl.note: Introduction. - Bar-Jesus (Acts 13.4-12). - Simon magus (Acts 8.4-25). - Ananias and Sapphira (Acts 4.32–5.11). - Conclusion. - Comparison of the apostles' proclamations of judgment on those who threatened the early Christian community with Greek and Coptic "magical" texts helps to place the curses of Acts in the context of cursing traditions in the wider ancient Mediterranean world.
